text.card: A star about 95 parsecs away, 1.9 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.9 solar radii and 1.17 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,815 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 224693
quotes.card: HD 224693, also named Axólotl, is a star in the equatorial constellation of Cetus, and is positioned near the western constellation border with Aquarius.
quotes.introduction: It can be viewed with a small telescope but is too faint to be seen with the naked eye, having an apparent visual magnitude of 8.23.
